### [1] [Strike a Chord! Modal Kinetic Typography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38325)
*Maham Tanveer,Jiyeon Han,Nanxuan Zhao,Hao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出模态动态字体：以字形矢量轮廓的有限元振型构建运动，仅由冻结视频扩散模型监督振幅与相位，实现概念表达、字形清晰且平滑循环的动画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有方法存在两类缺陷：基于视频分数蒸馏的自由点优化逐点逐帧独立优化，导致轮廓撕裂与抖动；结构化方法依赖骨架/关键点等类别先验，需额外知识且限制表达。目标是让字形自身驱动运动，实现形状与运动的解耦。

Method: 1) 对矢量字形轮廓构建有限元特征值问题，得到整体与各部件的最软振型以支持弯曲；2) 零能量解（刚性平移与旋转）以闭式形式作用于各部件，使部件可整体位移；3) 用冻结视频扩散模型仅监督各模态的振幅与相位；4) 仅需语言模型为整个字母表一次性生成的各字母运动部件名称列表作为先验。

Result: 相比 Dynamic Typography 与 AniClipart，运动更关节化、更平滑，概念对齐相当或更优；字形撕裂少于 Dynamic Typography；人类评估中更受偏好，包括仅靠运动传达概念的冻结形状设置；在人类评估中也优于 Astra (GPT-6)。

Conclusion: 基于字形固有振型的模态参数化可限制梯度搜索空间，天然产生沿轮廓平滑、整周期谐波驱动的无缝循环运动；形状与运动在构造上解耦，单一基础轮廓可被塑形且模态驱动不改变轮廓，从而支持不改形仅动画的生成方式。

Abstract: We introduce modal kinetic typography, which animates a vector glyph to express a semantic concept while keeping it legible. Our key idea is to build motion from the glyph's natural vibration modes. Specifically, a finite-element eigenproblem assembled from the vector outline yields the glyph's softest modes, for the whole letter and for each of its parts, allowing it to bend. The problem's zero-energy solutions, i.e., rigid translations and rotations, are applied in closed form to each part, allowing parts to also move as blocks. To animate the glyph, a frozen video diffusion model supervises only the modes' amplitudes and phases. Our modal approach addresses two weaknesses of prior work. Free-form point optimization under video score distillation (SDS) moves each point and frame independently along noisy gradients, tearing the outline and causing jitter. In contrast, our modes are smooth along the outline and driven by a few whole-cycle harmonics, which restricts these gradients to smooth, seamlessly looping motion. On the other hand, structured alternatives rely on skeletons or keypoints from category-specific priors, whereas our modes come from the glyph itself; the only prior is a list naming each letter's moving parts, generated once for the whole alphabet by a language model. In modal kinetic typography, shape and motion are disentangled by construction: a single base outline is sculpted toward the concept, and the modal drive cannot alter it, so a letter can also be animated without being reshaped. Our method produces more articulated and smoother motion than Dynamic Typography and AniClipart at comparable or better concept alignment, with less glyph tearing than Dynamic Typography, and is preferred by human raters, including in a frozen-shape setting where motion alone must carry the concept. Our results were also preferred over Astra (GPT-6) by human raters.

</details>


### [2] [Lens Flare Removal and Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39527)
*Tarun Yenamandra,Jonathon Luiten,Daniel Cremers,Nathan Matsuda*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出面向大尺寸镜头光晕的去除数据集与扩散模型，并构建基于主点对称性的光晕表示，与3DGS联合优化，实现3D场景中光晕与场景的显式分解、可渲染与可迁移编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 镜头光晕源于相机成像系统而非底层场景，会显著降低3D重建等下游任务质量。现有方法仅能处理光源周围的小光晕，对充满整幅图像的大光晕效果不佳；同时光晕作为艺术工具在多视图中的一致表示与重建尚未被探索。

Method: 1) 构建大光晕去除数据集：结合公开真实数据与程序化生成流程；2) 在该数据集上微调扩散模型以去除复杂大光晕；3) 提出利用光晕关于相机主点对称性的光晕表示模型；4) 设计联合优化该光晕模型与3D高斯泼溅(3DGS)的计算流程，借助去除模型将3D场景分解为光晕与场景本身。

Result: 在既有基准与新建的大反射光晕基准上评估去除效果，直接量化光晕/场景分解质量，并证明流程对自动光源定位误差具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 重建的光晕是显式且可重渲染的，因此可被编辑并迁移到新图像与新3D场景中，实现大光晕去除与可控光晕合成的统一框架。

Abstract: The presence of lens flares in images can significantly reduce the quality of downstream application results for tasks such as 3D scene reconstruction. This is because lens flares are a property of the camera imaging system, and not a part of the underlying scene being modeled. There are previous methods that tackle the removal of small flares focused around a light source. However, existing methods struggle with large flares, such as those that fill the entire image. In this work, we compile a novel dataset for large-flare removal, combining publicly available real-world data with a procedural generation pipeline. We fine-tune a diffusion-based model on our dataset to remove complex, large lens flares. On the other hand, lens flares remain effective artistic tools, widely used in the media. While there are ways to simulate 2D flares, representing and reconstructing lens flares consistently across multiple views has not yet been explored. To achieve this, we introduce a flare representation model that leverages the symmetry of lens flares about the camera's principal point. We propose a computational pipeline to jointly optimize this flare model and a Gaussian splatting model (3DGS). This enables the decomposition of a 3D scene into lens flares and the scene itself, using our flare-removal model. Because the reconstructed flare is explicit and re-renderable, it can be edited and transferred to novel images and new 3D scenes. We evaluate removal on an established benchmark and a new one for large reflective flares, quantify the flare/scene decomposition directly, and show that the pipeline is robust to errors in automatic light-source localization.

</details>


### [3] [Evaluating Multi-Task Morphological Concept Learning for Pulmonary Nodule Malignancy Assessment in 3D CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38271)
*Namitha Narayanan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究探讨在3D CT肺结节分析中，将放射科医生标注的形态学特征（毛刺征、分叶征）与恶性风险联合学习是否能提升分类性能。结果显示多任务模型相较单任务模型无显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 形态学特征（如毛刺征、分叶征）对评估肺结节恶性风险具有重要价值。研究希望验证：在基于病灶中心3D CT体积的学习中，将医生标注的形态学特征作为辅助任务与恶性风险联合训练，能否改善分类表现。

Method: 使用LIDC-IDRI数据集，排除恶性评级不确定的样本后，纳入742例患者的3,918条读者级结节标注。采用患者级划分进行训练、验证与测试，测试集包含112例患者、628条读者标注。以单任务3D卷积神经网络为基线，与同时预测恶性风险、毛刺征和分叶征的多任务模型进行对比。采用患者级bootstrap分析评估差异。

Result: 单任务模型的平衡准确率为0.548，ROC-AUC为0.552；多任务模型分别为0.539和0.558。患者级bootstrap分析显示ROC-AUC差异为0.005（95% CI: -0.087至0.090），平衡准确率差异为-0.009（95% CI: -0.067至0.043）。辅助任务类别高度不平衡，预测性能有限。

Conclusion: 引入形态学特征并未明显改善恶性风险分类性能，凸显了类别平衡、标签构建方式以及读者级标注结构在多任务肺CT分析中的重要性。

Abstract: Morphological characteristics such as spiculation and lobulation play an important role in assessing pulmonary nodules on computed tomography (CT), particularly in relation to malignancy risk. This study examines whether learning radiologist-annotated morphological features together with malignancy risk from lesion-centred 3D CT volumes improves classification performance. The Lung Image Database Consortium and Image Database Resource Initiative (LIDC-IDRI) dataset was used, comprising 3,918 reader-level nodule annotations from 742 patients after excluding indeterminate malignancy ratings. Patient-level splitting was used for training, validation, and testing, with 112 patients and 628 reader annotations in the held-out test set. A single-task 3D convolutional neural network was compared with a multi-task model predicting malignancy risk, spiculation, and lobulation. The single-task model achieved a balanced accuracy of 0.548 and receiver operating characteristic area under the curve (ROC-AUC) of 0.552, while the multi-task model achieved 0.539 and 0.558, respectively. Patient-level bootstrap analysis showed an ROC-AUC difference of 0.005 (95% confidence interval (CI): -0.087 to 0.090) and a balanced-accuracy difference of -0.009 (95% CI: -0.067 to 0.043). The auxiliary tasks were strongly imbalanced and showed limited predictive performance. Overall, including morphological features did not clearly improve malignancy-risk classification, showing the importance of class balance, label formulation, and reader-level annotation structure in multi-task pulmonary CT analysis.

</details>


### [4] [Masked Swingers: Harnessing Data Augmentation to Advance Autoencoders for Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38278)
*Anthony Fuller,Scott C. Lowe,Daniel G. Kyrollos,Graham W. Taylor,Evan Shelhamer,James R. Green*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Masked Swingers，通过双视图增强、独立掩码编码并交换CLS令牌，学习视图无关的全局表征，全面提升MAE在下游任务上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督学习无需标注，其中掩码自编码器（MAE）最为成功，但MAE仅重构自身输入，缺乏对视图无关的整体语义表征学习，限制了向细粒度等下游任务的高效迁移。

Method: 对同一图像进行两种不同增强，获得两个视图；对每个视图分别进行掩码并编码；在解码被掩码的patch之前，将两个视图的全局表征（CLS token）互换，从而促使模型学习视图无关的图像摘要。

Result: 在ImageNet-1K kNN上较MAE提升+3–5%；细粒度任务大幅提升：实例检索相对+45%，动物re-ID +22%，Omniglot字符识别+76%；在三个新的state-probing数据集上相对MAE降低错误率64%。

Conclusion: 通过交换双视图全局表征，Masked Swingers能学到视图无关的摘要表征，在分类与细粒度任务上显著优于MAE，并为世界建模提供新途径。

Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) removes the need for annotations and makes models that are capable across more domains than supervised learning. The autoencoder SSL framework learns by reconstructing its own input after information loss through a bottleneck or noise injection. Masked autoencoders (MAE) are the most successful instantiation of this framework: they encode a random subset of patches, then decode the masked-out patches. In this work, we introduce key modifications to improve MAEs. Our method augments an image in two different ways, then masks and encodes each view separately. It then exchanges the global representations (CLS tokens) between views before decoding the masked patches. By design, our Masked Swingers encourages learning a view-agnostic summary of the image to facilitate efficient transfer. We perform extensive experiments, and find Masked Swingers outperforms MAE by +3-5% on ImageNet-1K kNN and provides large gains on fine-grained tasks, e.g., relative gains of +45% on instance retrieval, +22% on animal re-ID, and +76% on Omniglot character recognition. To boot, Swingers reduces error -64% relative to MAE on three new state-probing datasets, opening the door to world modeling. Welcome to our Swingers party.

</details>


### [5] [GaugeVLM: Structuring Spatial Supervision with Measured Geometric Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38285)
*Hongbo Wang,Zihan Lin,Wenkui Yang,Shiran Ge,Yuang Ai,Jie Cao,Huaibo Huang,Ran He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GaugeVLM，通过在显式3D场景中对物体和相机进行受控干预，构建具有已测量关系差异与跨视角共有真值的关联观测，并设计GaugeDPO目标将测量误差转化为偏好margin、监督跨视角规范排序、并把干预引起的答案几率对比与关系变化及视角尺度相连，从而提升VLM空间关系推理的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在同一空间关系的不同视角下会自相矛盾，且当该关系发生变化时无法作出响应。解决这些问题需要能够刻画误差幅度以及跨观测几何依赖的监督信号，而基于单一答案或序数偏好的训练方式将这两类信息隐式化，无法提供足够监督。

Method: 在显式3D场景中对物体与相机实施受控干预，生成带有已测量空间关系差异和跨视角共享真值的关联观测；核心目标GaugeDPO将测量误差转化为偏好margin，直接监督跨视角的正确规范排序，并将干预引起的答案几率对比与测量到的关系变化按视角特定尺度关联；同时给出规范性预测误差的理论界，并证明跨视角约束与干预约束可被联合满足。

Result: 在三个VLM骨干网络上，GaugeVLM相较监督微调在全部10项既定空间指标上均有提升；主7B模型在MSMU距离与QSpatial+上分别提升15.0和18.9个百分点；增益还延伸到自动驾驶与具身推理任务，显示跨域泛化能力。

Conclusion: 通过将空间监督中的误差幅度与几何依赖性显式化，GaugeDPO能够有效提升VLM跨视角空间关系推理的一致性与响应能力，并在多骨干、多任务与跨域场景中取得稳定增益。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can contradict themselves across views of the same spatial relation and fail to respond when that relation changes. Addressing these failures requires supervision that captures error magnitude and geometric dependencies across observations, both of which remain implicit in training on individual answers or ordinal preferences. Therefore, we introduce GaugeVLM, which makes this structure explicit through controlled object and camera interventions in explicit 3D scenes, producing linked observations with measured differences between spatial relations and shared truths across views. To translate this structure into learning signals, its core objective, GaugeDPO, converts measured errors into preference margins, directly supervises correct canonical rankings across views, and links intervention-induced answer-odds contrasts to measured relation changes with view-specific scales. Our analysis bounds canonical prediction error and establishes that the cross-view and intervention constraints can be jointly satisfied. Empirically, GaugeVLM improves all 10 established spatial metrics over supervised fine-tuning across three VLM backbones, with the main 7B model gaining 15.0 and 18.9 percentage points on MSMU distance and QSpatial+, respectively. These gains also extend to autonomous driving and embodied reasoning, demonstrating the robust generalization across domains.

</details>


### [6] [It Takes Little to Rewrite Perception: Targeted Semantic Substitution in Vision-Language Models at $ε\leq 4/255$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38298)
*Binchi Zhang,Atrisha Sarkar,Apurva Narayan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文证明视觉语言模型（VLM）在 ε≤4/255 扰动范围内并非鲁棒：通过在其融合后（post-merger）token 空间对齐源图与目标图各模态流，可实现定向语义替换，并在图像和视频上取得显著攻击成功率，同时观察到"语义融合"现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 广泛应用于安全关键场景，评估其对对抗扰动的可控性（trustworthiness）是必要前提。已有表示对齐攻击在 ε≤4/255 时成功率有限，导致学界认为 VLM 在该范围内是鲁棒的。作者质疑这一结论，试图证明该鲁棒性并不成立。

Method: 在白盒威胁模型下，将源图像的每一模态流（stream）与目标图像的对应流在受害 VLM 的融合后 token 空间中进行对齐，从而实现定向语义替换。评价采用严格成功准则：模型须同时命名目标、确认其存在并否认源。攻击在图像与视频两种设置下验证。

Result: 图像上，目标语义在 ε=2/255 即出现，完全替换率在 ε=4/255 达到 38%；视频上，完全替换率在 ε=1/255 达到 35.9%。此外观察到"语义融合"现象：LLM 将矛盾的视觉信号合理化（rationalize）为连贯叙事。

Conclusion: VLM 在 ε≤4/255 范围内对定向语义替换并不鲁棒，此前基于表示对齐攻击得出的鲁棒性结论不成立。融合后 token 空间的对齐是有效攻击面，且模型存在将矛盾视觉信息合理化的语义融合缺陷，提示其可信度评估需重新审视。

Abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are widely deployed in safety-critical scenarios, and understanding to which extent they can be controlled by adversarial perturbation is a prerequisite for evaluating their trustworthiness. Existing representation-alignment attacks, which make a VLM perceive a target image, achieve limited success at $\varepsilon \leq 4/255$. Therefore, VLMs seems robust to perturbations in this range. We show that this robustness does not hold, as targeted semantic substitution succeeds within the same range. Specifically, we align each stream of the source image with its counterpart in the target image in the victim VLM's post-merger token space, operating under a white-box threat model. We evaluate under a strict success criterion, requiring the model to simultaneously name the target, confirm its presence, and deny the source. In images, target semantics appear at $\varepsilon = 2/255$ and complete replacement reaches 38\% at $\varepsilon = 4/255$. On video, complete replacement reaches 35.9\% at $\varepsilon = 1/255$. We also observe a phenomenon of \textit{semantic fusion}, where Large Language Model (LLM) rationalizes contradictory visual signals into a coherent narrative.

</details>


### [7] [ExploreNet: Learning Where to Explore in Diffusion GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38329)
*Shuyue Stella Li,Xiaochuang Han,Yulia Tsvetkov,Luke Zettlemoyer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 EXPLORENET，一种可学习的自适应探索分布策略，为潜空间每个元素预测噪声尺度，替代 Flow-GRPO 等群体相对 RL 方法中的各向同性高斯噪声，在 SD3.5 Medium 上显著提升生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有群体相对强化学习方法（如 Flow-GRPO）在对图像生成器进行后训练时，会在每个去噪步骤加入各向同性高斯噪声来探索。该噪声决定了模型从哪些 rollout 中学习，但它对潜变量的所有通道和空间位置施加相同扰动。事实上，不同潜元素对生成图像的影响程度不同，因此探索应当适应这些差异。

Method: 作者引入 EXPLORENET 来学习自适应探索分布。它是一个策略，在观测到任何奖励之前，根据当前潜变量、去噪步骤和提示词，为每个潜元素预测一个噪声尺度；其训练信号来自每个 rollout 组的奖励离散度（reward spread），训练完成后即被丢弃，推理流程保持不变。

Result: 在 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium 上，EXPLORENET 相比 Flow-GRPO 在留出的 GenEval2 上提升 14%，并迁移到两个独立的组合性基准以及五个偏好与图像质量模型，达到 67.2% 的人类偏好胜率。

Conclusion: 在群体相对扩散 RL 实验中，作者发现：探索是可学习的；探索分布的形状比其幅度更重要；rollout 的质量比 rollout 的数量更有效。

Abstract: Group-relative RL methods such as Flow-GRPO post-train image generators by exploring with isotropic Gaussian noise added at every denoising step. This noise decides which rollouts the model learns from, yet it perturbs every channel and spatial position of the latent equally. In this paper, we instead show that latent elements differ in how much they change the generated image, so exploration should adapt to these differences. We introduce EXPLORENET to learn an adaptive exploration distribution. EXPLORENET is a policy that predicts a noise scale for every latent element from the current latent, the denoising step, and the prompt, before any reward is observed; it is trained on the reward spread of each rollout group and discarded after training, leaving inference unchanged. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, EXPLORENET improves held-out GenEval2 by 14% over Flow-GRPO, transfers to two independent compositional benchmarks and five preference and image-quality models, and reaches a 67.2% human preference win-rate. Overall, across our group-relative diffusion RL experiments, we find that exploration is learnable, the shape of the exploration distribution outweighs its magnitude, and rollout quality is more effective than rollout quantity.

</details>


### [8] [Learning Semantic Inpainting for Animatable Gaussian Head Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38343)
*Pilseo Park,Fizza Rubab,Yiying Tong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SInGA，一种从单张图像学习可动画高斯头部化身语义补全的方法，在UV空间补全未观测面部区域，无需逐身份优化即可泛化并驱动动画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有化身方法多依赖多视角观测，在单视角设置下缺乏对未观测区域的有效处理，限制了其适用性。

Method: 在UV空间定义语义补全框架，利用UV表示的结构化拓扑与人脸固有对称性线索，从观测区域提取特征并补全未观测区域，进而回归高斯属性实现高斯补全；同时在每个表面/像素位置堆叠多个高斯以增强细节。

Result: 实验表明，该方法生成的头部化身质量高，完整性与身份保持更优，支持逼真动画，并可从未观测视角实现一致渲染。

Conclusion: SInGA通过UV空间语义补全与多高斯堆叠，实现了单图可泛化的可动画高斯头部化身，兼具完整性与身份一致性。

Abstract: We present SInGA, a novel method for learning Semantic Inpainting for animatable Gaussian head Avatars from a single image. Existing avatar approaches often rely on multi-view observations and lack effective handling of unobserved regions in single-view settings, limiting their applicability in such scenarios.   <summary>Details</summary>

Method: IVL为免训练框架：通过双模式提示从少样本支持图像中提取视觉特征，将语义描述与原初视觉观察相结合，组织为逐类别的特征字典；推理时采用分层过滤，识别具有空间基础的类别证据以完成分类。

Result: 在多个远域分布外基准上，IVL在两种VLM骨干下均取得最高总体准确率，并产生可解释、特征可追溯的预测。

Abstract: Generative vision-language models (VLMs) such as Qwen-VL and LLaVA achieve strong zero-shot performance on tasks overlapping with their pretraining distribution, yet fail on specialized domains where the required discriminative features were never learned, a regime we term distant out-of-distribution (OOD). Standard adaptation methods cannot overcome this representational absence because they operate within the encoder's existing feature space. However, VLMs retain a robust descriptive capacity even when discrimination collapses: a model that cannot classify a medical scan can still articulate its visual patterns. Exploiting this asymmetry, we introduce Inductive Visual Logic (IVL), a training-free framework that constructs classification knowledge from the model's surviving descriptive ability. IVL extracts visual traits from few-shot support images through dual-mode prompting, combining semantic descriptions with primitive visual observations, and organizes them into per-class trait dictionaries. At inference, hierarchical filtering identifies spatially grounded trait evidence for classification. Across multiple distant-OOD benchmarks, IVL achieves the highest aggregate accuracy under two VLM backbones while producing interpretable, trait-traceable predictions.

</details>

*L. D. M. S. Sai Teja,Ufaq Khan,N. Siva Gopala Krishna,Satyajit Tourani,Ashshak Sharifdeen,Fida Mohammad Thoker,Bernard Ghanem,Muhammad Haris Khan*

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Layered-VQA 基准，将图像分解为有序 RGBA 图层并按支持/最小充分/干扰标注，评估 11 个开源 VLM 与 2 个闭源模型，发现证据碎片化会导致组合损失、Oracle 反转与定位退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VQA 基准通常一次性给出完整图像和问题，但真实应用中 VLM 常需对裁剪、分割、检索或逐步揭示的视觉证据进行推理。作者想探究：当同一信息被碎片化时，模型究竟损失了什么。

Method: 构建 Layered-VQA：包含 93 个场景、300 个问题；每张图像被分解为有序 RGBA 图层，可精确重组原始场景；每个问题标注支持层、最小充分层和干扰层。评估 11 个 3B–32B 开源权重 VLM 和 2 个闭源模型，共 187,200 轮对话，并由 1.74M 次开源模型交叉评判打分。

Result: 发现三类一致失败：(1) 组合损失：碎片化问题影响较小，但碎片化场景显著降低准确率，重新组合相同图层可基本恢复性能；(2) Oracle 反转：即使使用 oracle 选出的充分证据，表现也可能差于完整场景；(3) 定位损失：所需证据越多，grounding 退化速度远快于答案准确率。

Conclusion: 拥有正确的视觉证据还不够；证据如何被组合与呈现，决定模型能否使用并定位它。正确的证据不足够——VLM 还需要证据所属的完整场景。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly reason over visual evidence that is cropped, segmented, retrieved, or revealed over time. Yet most VQA benchmarks present the complete image and question at once. We ask what models lose when the same information is fragmented. We introduce Layered-VQA, with 93 scenes and 300 questions. Each image is decomposed into ordered RGBA layers that exactly recompose the original scene, and each question is annotated with supporting, minimal-sufficient, and distractor layers. We evaluate eleven open-weight VLMs from 3B to 32B parameters and two proprietary models with a scale of 187,200 conversations, graded by 1.74M open-model cross-judgments. We find three consistent failures. Loss in Composition: fragmenting the question has a small effect, but fragmenting the scene substantially reduces accuracy; recomposing the same layers largely restores performance. Oracle Inversion: even oracle-selected sufficient evidence can perform worse than the complete scene. Loss in Grounding: as more evidence is required, grounding degrades much faster than answer accuracy. Together, these results show that having the right visual evidence is not enough. How that evidence is composed and presented determines whether models can use and ground it. The right evidence is not enough: VLMs need the scene it came from.

</details>

*Max Ku,Jiaojiao Fan,Zekun Hao,Francesco Ferroni,Heng Wang,Wenhu Chen,Ming-Yu Liu,Prithvijit Chattopadhyay*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PhyProbe：基于冻结时空编码器特征+轻量打分头，通过成对排序、噪声标量回归与锚点校准的统一目标训练，输出[0,1]物理一致性违规分数，在多数成对基准上优于现有方法，且在无对应与生成-生成场景提升最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成视频的物理一致性评估是基础性难题。现有方法有两类局限：基于现成视觉语言模型的评估器对物理动力学常"短视"；基于人工标注微调的评估器则过拟合数据集特定线索、泛化差。核心困难在于现有监督源只能可靠提供相对排序或绝对分数之一，难以在不同设置下同时稳定提供两者。

Method: PhyProbe从冻结的预训练时空编码器中提取特征，经轻量打分头映射为标量物理一致性违规分数；训练采用统一目标，结合成对排序（pairwise ranking）、对噪声标量标注的回归（regression）以及基于锚点的校准（anchor-based calibration），监督来自精心筛选的异构监督源集合。

Result: 在涵盖真实-生成与生成-生成配对、不同对应关系的多数成对基准上，PhyProbe优于先前方法；在无对应（no-correspondence）和生成-生成设置中收益最大，而现有微调评估器在这些场景下性能急剧下降。其与人类判断相关性高，基于排序与线性指标结果接近一致，说明分数既排序良好又锚定在稳定的[0,1]尺度上。此外，尽管未使用显式通用偏好标签，PhyProbe在人类偏好基准上也具竞争力，这与"物理违规与更广泛的质量退化相互纠缠"的观察一致。

Conclusion: 通过统一融合排序、回归与锚点校准监督，可在冻结编码器上构建兼具良好排序性与稳定绝对尺度的物理一致性评估器，并具备跨设置泛化能力；物理一致性信号与通用视频质量/偏好高度相关，为生成视频评估提供了可扩展的范式。

Abstract: Evaluating the physical consistency of generated videos remains a fundamental challenge. Existing approaches rely on off-the-shelf vision-language models, which can often be myopic to physical dynamics, or fine-tuned evaluators trained on human annotations, which overfit to dataset-specific cues and fail to generalize. A key challenge is that existing supervision sources provide either relative ordering or absolute scores, but not both reliably and consistently across varied settings. To this end, we introduce PhyProbe, an evaluator that extracts features from a frozen pretrained spatio-temporal encoder and maps them to a scalar physical consistency violation score via a lightweight scoring head. PhyProbe is trained through a unified objective combining pairwise ranking, regression on noisy scalar annotations, and anchor-based calibration over a curated set of heterogeneous supervision sources. Experiments show that PhyProbe outperforms prior methods on most pairwise benchmarks spanning real-generated and generated-generated pairs under varying correspondence, with the largest gains in no-correspondence and generated-generated settings where existing fine-tuned evaluators degrade sharply. PhyProbe achieves strong correlation with human judgments, with close agreement between rank-based and linear metrics, indicating that scores are both well ordered and anchored to a stable [0, 1] scale. Further, despite being trained on supervision indicative of physical consistency, without explicit general-preference labels, PhyProbe also performs competitively on human preference benchmarks: consistent with the observation that physics violations are entangled with broader quality degradations.

</details>

*Kirill Koltsov,Aleksandr Gushchin,Dmitriy Vatolin,Anastasia Antsiferova*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出分解式思维链流水线，结合文档篡改检测器与两个LoRA微调的Qwen3-VL-32B模型，实现多语言文本图像伪造检测、篡改定位、攻击类型识别与取证报告生成，获ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics挑战赛第三名，并给出数据准备、测试时增强、区域渲染、蒸馏协议与训练配置及多项消融实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文档伪造已从像素级篡改演变为同时改变外观与语义，并针对OCR与LLM流水线发起攻击。既有方法多停留在判断真伪，难以同时完成篡改定位、攻击类型识别与可读取证报告生成。挑战赛因此要求系统兼具检测、定位、分类与报告生成能力。

Method: 分解式思维链（CoT）流水线：文档篡改检测器（DTD）生成篡改概率图并转为带编号候选区域；第一个Qwen3-VL-32B模型（Filterer）验证区域并给出初步伪造类型；第二个模型（Semantic Detective）合并并重定位存留区域，检索像素级检测器不可见的纯语义异常，并撰写最终报告。两模型均通过从可访问真值掩码与报告的Qwen3-VL-235B特权教师中蒸馏CoT轨迹训练，均采用LoRA适配不同子任务。

Result: 在ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics挑战赛中获得第三名。论文详细报告了数据准备、测试时增强、区域渲染、蒸馏协议与训练配置，并对检测器阈值、提示设计与流水线分解方式进行了消融实验。

Conclusion: 分解式CoT流水线结合像素级检测器与多模态大模型，可有效覆盖外观篡改与语义篡改，并输出带证据的取证报告；消融实验为阈值、提示与流水线结构设计提供了参考，验证了该分解范式的有效性。

Abstract: Document text forgery has evolved beyond simple pixel-level manipulation: modern attacks alter not only the appearance of a document but also its meaning, and increasingly target the OCR & LLM pipelines that consume such documents. The ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics challenge therefore requires systems that not only decide whether a multilingual text image is forged, but also localize the point of manipulation, identify the attack type, and produce a human-readable forensic report with supporting evidence. We present our solution, a decomposed chain-of-thought (CoT) pipeline that combines a document tampering detector (DTD) with two Qwen3-VL-32B vision-language models, each LoRA-adapted to a distinct sub-task. DTD produces tampering probability maps that are converted into numbered candidate regions; a first model (the Filterer) validates these regions and assigns a preliminary forgery type, while a second model (the Semantic Detective) merges and re-grounds the surviving regions, searches for purely semantic anomalies that are invisible to pixel-level detectors, and writes the final report. Both models are trained by distilling chain-of-thought traces from a privileged Qwen3-VL-235B teacher that has access to ground-truth masks and reports. Our approach secured third place in the ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics challenge. We describe the data preparation, test-time augmentation, region rendering, distillation protocol, and training configuration in detail, and report ablations over detector thresholds, prompt designs, and pipeline decompositions.

</details>


### [14] [VidHarness: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Cost-Efficient Long Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38413)
*Susan Liang,Jianmin Wu,Daxiang Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VidHarness 提出用 MCTS 自动化设计视频智能体框架，通过多保真验证降低成本，并用混合框架按帧预算路由，在长视频理解基准上超越最强手工基线最多 11.2 分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型可回答小时级长视频问题，但逐帧处理代价过高，而问题所需证据通常仅涉及几秒。现有视频智能体（冻结 VLM 外挂程序）能选择性观察视频，但依赖专家手工设计，需经历缓慢的“构建—测试”循环，效率低且难以优化。

Method: 提出 VidHarness 自动化框架设计：由 harness proposer 基于执行反馈在演化环境中迭代进化框架；将演化组织为蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）以跳出贪心优化的局部最优；引入不确定性感知的多保真验证，用少量问题筛选新框架、仅提升有潜力的候选；并针对最优框架随帧预算变化的问题，引入 mixture-of-harness，按每个问题的帧预算路由到专用框架。

Result: 在 LongVideoBench、Video-MME、Video-Holmes 上取得新的 SOTA，较最强手工视频智能体最高提升 11.2 分；在知识密集型基准 Video-MMMU 和 MMVU 上具备泛化能力，且所用帧数不足均匀采样的一半。

Conclusion: VidHarness 证明了视频理解框架设计可被自动化，结合 MCTS 演化、多保真验证与混合路由，能在显著降低帧成本的同时取得更优的长视频理解性能，并具备跨基准泛化能力。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer questions about hour-long videos, but processing every frame is prohibitively expensive, even though the evidence for a question usually spans only a few seconds. Video agents, i.e., harness programs wrapped around a frozen VLM, address this by observing the video selectively, yet existing harnesses are hand-crafted by experts through slow build-and-test cycles. We propose VidHarness, a framework that automates harness design for cost-efficient long video understanding, in which a harness proposer iteratively evolves harnesses based on execution feedback from an evolution environment. To escape the local optima of greedy refinement, we organize the evolution as Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS), and to reduce the evaluation cost, we integrate uncertainty-aware multi-fidelity validation, which screens new harnesses on a few questions and promotes only the promising ones. Since the best harness varies with the frame budget, we further introduce a mixture-of-harness that routes each question to a harness specialized for its budget. VidHarness sets new state-of-the-art results on LongVideoBench, Video-MME, and Video-Holmes, outperforms the strongest hand-crafted video agent by up to $11.2$ points, and generalizes to the knowledge-intensive benchmarks Video-MMMU and MMVU with fewer than half of the frames of uniform sampling.

</details>


### [15] [LoopVL: Recurrent Visual Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38426)
*Zhe Qian,Ziyang Gong,Zhongxing Xu,Hehan Li,Zhonghua Wang,Fei Luo,Mingxuan Wang,Xue Yang,Shiwei liu,Yanbiao Ma,Junchi Yan,Jungong Han*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究循环（recurrent）结构能否有效迁移到视觉-语言模型中，以共享参数支持更深层的多模态计算。

Abstract: We introduce LoopVL to study whether Loop Transformers can be effectively extended to vision- language models. LoopVL combines Module-Loop and Model-Loop computation to iteratively update a unified vision-language state through shared modules. We train LoopVL from scratch through language pre-training, multimodal training, and post-training. LoopVL outperforms a range of similarly sized and larger non-recurrent models on multimodal understanding and visual reasoning benchmarks. We also observe Visual Aha Moments in LoopVL, characterized by pronounced shifts in visual attention across loops. LoopVL provides practical evidence for recurrent vision-language modeling and offers an intuitive perspective on how shared parameters can support deeper multimodal computation over continuously evolving visual-language states.

</details>

*Shengyun Zhong,Xinkang Zhao,Ziyuan Chu,Linchao Zhu*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MOBA电竞赛事实时解说要求视觉语言模型逐秒流畅且准确地叙述比赛，但现有流式VLM虽然语言自然，却常遗漏击杀、目标等关键事件。游戏遥测数据精确记录了每个事件发生的时间，可作为监督信号解决这一不足。

Result: 在MOBACast-Bench上，MOBA-VL在完整比赛上取得最高Overall分数（63.25，对比StreamingVLM的55.12），在片段上同样最高（63.45，对比DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash的56.22）；事件定位信用机制将事件召回率从监督微调的34.5提升至42.1。

  <summary>Details</summary>

### [18] [PAMI: Part Anchored Motion for Text to Human-Object Interaction Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38466)
*Chuqiao Li,Xianghui Xie,Yong Cao,Andreas Geiger,Gerard Pons-Moll*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PAMI 提出“部件锚定”的交互生成框架，借鉴 Hough 变换思想，让身体部件锚点对物体运动进行投票，并通过 PamiVAE 学习交互隐空间；配合由粗到细的 PamiGen 与 PamiRefiner，在 InterAct 上实现更忠实、更精确的人-物交互生成，接触召回率较此前最优方法提升 14.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本条件下的全身人-物交互（HOI）生成需要同时合成人体运动与物体轨迹，并在时间上保持精确协调。现有方法多将人与物体表示为两条独立轨迹并隐式预测全局人-物耦合关系，这种复杂且动态变化的关系难以隐式学习，常导致物体漂移、漏接触和穿模等问题。

Method: 提出 PAMI（Part-Anchored Motion framework for Interaction generation）。核心思想受经典 Hough 变换启发：将物体运动表示为相对于多个身体部件锚点的关系，让身体部件锚点对物体运动进行“投票”以定位物体运动；用 PamiVAE 学习交互隐空间，并解码逐帧权重来聚合各部件特定的投票。在该表示基础上采用由粗到细的层级生成：PamiGen 先在结构化隐空间中根据文本生成粗粒度人-物交互，PamiRefiner 再利用混合表面感知表示递归求解细粒度接触几何，该表示结合捕获整体部件影响的长程探针（long-range probes）与解析物体表面附近细节接触的短程传感器（short-range sensors）。

Result: 在 InterAct 数据集上，PAMI 生成的交互比以往方法更忠实，人体相对物体运动更准确，接触召回率较此前最优方法提升 14.5%。大量消融实验验证了部件锚定投票表示与混合表面感知细化两者的贡献。

Conclusion: 通过部件锚定投票表示替代隐式全局耦合建模，并辅以由粗到细的混合表面感知细化，PAMI 有效缓解了物体漂移、漏接触与穿模问题，显著提升文本驱动全身人-物交互生成的质量与接触精度。

Abstract: Text-conditioned full-body human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires synthesizing human motion and object trajectories that match the input text while remaining precisely coordinated over time. Most methods represent the human and object as separate trajectories and predict the global human-object couplings. Learning this complex, dynamically changing relationship implicitly, however, often yields object drift, missed contact, and penetration. We introduce PAMI, a Part-Anchored Motion framework for Interaction generation. Inspired by the classic Hough Transform, our key idea is to localize object motion by letting body-part anchors vote for it: we express object motion relative to multiple body-part anchors and use PamiVAE to learn an interaction latent space, decoding frame-wise weights that aggregate these part-specific votes. Building on this representation, PAMI generates interactions in a coarse-to-fine hierarchy. PamiGen first generates a coarse human-object interaction from text in this structured latent space, and PamiRefiner then recursively resolves fine-grained contact geometry using a hybrid surface-sensing representation, combining long-range probes that capture overall body-part influence with short-range sensors that resolve detailed contacts near the object surface. Experiments on InterAct show that PAMI generates more faithful interactions and more accurate human-relative object motion than previous methods, achieving 14.5% higher contact recall than the previous state of the art. Extensive ablations validate the contributions of both the part-anchored voting representation and hybrid surface-sensing refinement.

</details>


### [19] [Curating Synthetic Data for Task-Specific Visual Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38476)
*Saptarshi Neil Sinha,Paul Julius Kühn,Michael Weinmann*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文主张专用视觉系统的核心问题不是"生成更多数据"，而是"生成哪些数据"，提出"策展式合成数据"（curated synthetic data）概念，并比较程序化渲染、物理仿真、生成式AI三种策展范式，结合工业表面缺陷检测、退化彩色干板修复、RGB与事件数据的6DoF位姿估计三个案例，分析合成与真实数据的混合训练策略，结论是混合流水线最具前景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用数据集无法提供任务所需的领域先验，而人工标注昂贵、不精确或不可行，因此合成数据在专用视觉任务中价值突出。但作者认为当前关注点有偏差：真正关键的问题不是数据量的扩充，而是如何有针对性地选择与设计所生成的数据。

Method: 提出并讨论"策展式合成数据"，即围绕给定任务刻意设计场景内容、外观变化、传感特性和标注。系统比较三种互补的策展范式：(1) 程序化渲染——对场景参数显式控制，标注由构建过程自然获得；(2) 物理仿真——编码观测效应背后的机制，产生精确对齐的监督对；(3) 生成式AI——从小规模真实种子集学习传感器特定外观，实现可信真实感。并通过工业表面缺陷检测、退化数字彩色干板修复、RGB与事件数据6DoF位姿估计三个案例进行阐释。

Result: 三种范式各有取舍：程序化渲染标注精确但真实感有限；物理仿真监督对齐精确但建模成本高；生成式AI真实感强，却易出现幻觉和标注不准。基于案例，作者分析了合成与真实数据在不同数据规模与比例下的训练策略，说明各范式对不同数据条件的适配性。

Conclusion: 策展式合成数据应被理解为真实观测的补充而非替代。将可控监督（程序化渲染、物理仿真）与学习式外观（生成式AI）相结合的混合流水线，是实现可靠sim-to-real迁移最有前景的方向。

Abstract: Synthetic data are most valuable where general-purpose datasets cannot provide the domain-specific priors a task requires, and where manual annotation is expensive, imprecise, or infeasible. In this article we argue that the central question for specialized vision systems is not how to generate more data, but which data to generate. We therefore discuss curated synthetic data, whose scene content, appearance variations, sensing characteristics, and annotations are deliberately designed around a given task. We examine three complementary curation paradigms. Procedural rendering offers explicit control over scene parameters and the annotations follow by construction. Physically-based simulation encodes the mechanism behind an observed effect and yields exactly aligned supervision pairs. Generative AI learns sensor-specific appearance from small real seed sets and attains plausible realism, though it remains prone to hallucination and to inaccurate annotation. These paradigms are illustrated with examples from industrial surface defect detection, restoration of degraded digitized autochrome plates, and 6DoF pose estimation from RGB and event data. Using these examples, we analyze different data regimes and training strategies that combine synthetic and real data across these paradigms. We conclude that curated synthetic data are best understood as a complement to real observations, and that hybrid pipelines combining controllable supervision with learned appearance are the most promising direction for reliable sim-to-real transfer.

</details>


### [20] [Caption-Mediated Perceived-Safety Estimation for Pedestrian Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38479)
*Simon Parkinson,Paloma Liu,Wei Zheng,Mohammadreza Sheikhfathollahi*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行人路径规划需考虑感知安全，但端到端图像嵌入评分缺乏可解释性，用户难以审查评分依据；同时需要检验监督基准性能能否预测真实场景效果。

Method: 先生成并存储视觉-语言模型字幕，再完全从该文本的结构化特征推导感知风险类别；在相同下游流程下，用5个模型家族的9种字幕条件对比CLIP图像嵌入基线；并在两个地区36个选区、654,115张图像上部署。随后开展3,669条现场评分、494张图像、70个参与者会话的独立验证，以及单次确认性测试。

Conclusion: 显式自然语言中间表示可在保持可审查性的同时达到与图像嵌入相当的评分表现；但监督基准增益不能预测现场部署增益，需以真实验证为准；感知安全路径优化在较长行程中才产生明显绕行代价。

Abstract: This paper presents an explainable approach to pedestrian routing, in which perceived safety is estimated from street-level imagery through an explicit natural-language intermediate representation. A vision--language model caption is generated and stored before any scoring is undertaken, and the perceived-risk class is derived entirely from structured features of that stored text, so that every segment score remains inspectable by the user. Nine captioning conditions across five model families are benchmarked against a direct Contrastive Language--Image Pre-training (CLIP) image-embedding baseline under an identical downstream pipeline, and the caption-mediated representation is found to reach parity with the image embedding rather than to trail it. The approach was deployed over 654,115 images covering 36 electoral wards in two locations in Northern England (Manchester and Huddersfield). Independent field validation against 3,669 locally collected ratings of 494 images across 70 participant sessions established agreement that is statistically significant but modest, at $r=0.262$, against a measured noise ceiling of 0.737 imposed by disagreement between raters. A single-use confirmatory test then found that a pipeline 44\% stronger on the supervised benchmark did not produce measurable improvement in the field ($r=0.250$, $p=0.84$), so the benchmark gains did not predict the deployment gains in this case. Routing behaviour varies systematically with journey length. There is negligible change below 1\,km, reaching a median increase of 12.78\% in low-risk route length for a median detour of 2.73\% on journeys of 3 to 6 km.

</details>


### [21] [Beyond Layers: Position-Resolved Gradient Conflict and Position-Aware Modulation for Unified Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38485)
*Shuyang Jiang,Fucheng Deng,Yuchuan Luo,Zhenyu Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出"位置分辨的干扰图"，证明统一多模态模型中理解与生成梯度的冲突主要取决于视觉token在序列中的位置而非层，并据此提出位置感知调制（PAM）方法，在不改变架构的前提下提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMM）在共享参数上同时训练图像理解与自回归图像生成，两个目标相互干扰。已有的诊断与缓解方法都停留在层或专家粒度，即按层度量冲突并通过分离参数来解决，作者认为这种粒度掩盖了一个正交维度——冲突来源在序列中的位置。

Method: 作者提出位置分辨的干扰图，将理解-生成的梯度冲突归因到每一层内各个视觉token位置，仅需一次反向传播即可计算，成本为标准反向传播的1.2倍。在Show-o和Janus-Pro上分析位置对冲突方差的解释力（控制深度后的偏η²），并验证梯度范数归一化和语义内容相关性。基于该图提出位置感知调制（PAM）：仅在高冲突位置移除生成梯度中与理解反对齐的分量，不改变模型架构，且与逐层分离可叠加。

Result: 控制层深后，位置解释了冲突方差的重要部分：Show-o上偏η²为0.31（层为0.35），Janus-Pro上为0.15（层为0.30）。序列前四分之一对理解的平均梯度余弦为-0.18，后四分之一为-0.02；逐位置梯度范数归一化后效应仍保留80%，冲突强度与语义内容相关（Spearman ρ=0.64）。在匹配可训练参数预算下，PAM相比逐层分离在Show-o上MME提升+21、GenEval提升+2.4，POPE与整体FID持平；随机位置对照仅恢复约31%的增益。

Conclusion: 理解与生成的梯度冲突不仅存在于层维度，还显著存在于视觉token序列的位置维度，二者是互补的自由度。位置感知调制（PAM）验证了按位置消解冲突的有效性，且可与基于层的参数分离方法结合使用，为统一多模态模型的训练提供新的优化方向。

Abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) train image understanding and autoregressive image generation on shared parameters, and the two objectives are known to interfere. Existing diagnoses and remedies operate at the resolution of layers or experts, measuring conflict per layer and resolving it by separating parameters. We argue that this resolution hides an orthogonal axis. Generation in a UMM is next-token prediction over a raster sequence of visual tokens whose roles vary systematically with position, so how strongly a generation gradient interferes with understanding should depend on where in the sequence it originates. We introduce a position-resolved interference map that attributes understanding-generation gradient conflict to visual-token positions within every layer, computed from a single backward pass at $1.2\times$ the cost of a standard backward pass. On Show-o and Janus-Pro, position explains a large share of conflict variance after controlling for depth (partial $η^2=0.31$ vs. $0.35$ for layer on Show-o; $0.15$ vs. $0.30$ on Janus-Pro): the first quarter of the sequence has a mean gradient cosine of $-0.18$ against understanding, the last quarter $-0.02$. The dependence survives per-position gradient-norm normalization, retaining $80%$ of its effect size, and conflict strength tracks semantic content (Spearman $ρ=0.64$). Building on the map, we propose position-aware modulation (PAM), which removes the anti-aligned component of generation gradients only at high-conflict positions without changing the architecture. Under a matched trainable-parameter budget, PAM improves over layer-wise separation by $+21$ MME and $+2.4$ GenEval points on Show-o while matching it on POPE and overall FID; a random-position control recovers about $31%$ of the gain. Position-based and layer-based separation are complementary degrees of freedom and can be combined.

</details>


### [22] [Multidimensional Observer Model and Perceptual Dimensions of Human Image Quality Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38487)
*Sheng Zhao,Weikai Lin,Yuhao Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种多维观察者模型，将图像表示为潜在感知空间中的分布，并将人类判断建模为对含噪样本的比较，用以刻画人类图像质量判断背后的感知结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像质量判断既与日常人类任务密切相关，也是图像生成等机器视觉任务的基础，因此理解其背后的内在感知空间具有重要意义。

Method: 构建受灵长类腹侧通路神经表征约束、并拟合大规模行为数据的多维观察者模型；模型中图像被表示为潜在感知空间中的分布，人类判断被建模为对含噪样本的比较。

Result: 该模型在预测能力上可匹配现有指标，同时可用于分析感知结构；分析发现，解释人类图像质量判断所需的感知空间维度极低，即使考虑图像空间的稀疏性也是如此。空间的具体结构（如维度、所编码信息）在低层与高层质量判断之间存在差异。

Conclusion: 尽管视觉加工在早期共享视网膜编码，人类在视觉决策中会选择性地构建任务依赖的感知空间。

Abstract: Judging image quality is not only ecologically relevant to everyday human tasks, but also underpins many machine vision tasks such as image generation. This paper proposes a framework to understand the inherent perceptual space underlying image quality judgment in humans. We propose a multi-dimensional observer model that represents images as distributions in a latent perceptual space and that models human judgment as comparing noisy samples. Being constrained by neural representations in the primate ventral stream and fit to large-scale behavioral data, the model enables analysis of perceptual structure while matching the predictive power of existing metrics. Using this model, we find that the perceptual spaces needed to account for image quality judgment in humans are extremely low-dimensional compared to the image space even when considering its sparsity. The exact structure of the space (e.g., dimensionalities, information encoded) varies between low-level and high-level quality judgments, suggesting that, despite a shared retinal encoding in the beginning, humans selectively construct task-dependent perceptual spaces in visual decision making.

</details>


### [23] [GazeFlow: From Human Gaze Behavior to Generative Egocentric Gaze Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38519)
*Sheng Zhao,Weikai Lin,Yuhao Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出GazeFlow框架，将自我中心注视预测建模为以自上而下（任务）和自下而上（视觉显著性）信息为条件的注视轨迹联合分布，采用条件流匹配（CFM）迭代生成注视轨迹，在标准数据集上取得了逐帧指标的最优性能，且生成轨迹更符合人类注视的时间动态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自我中心注视预测下游应用广泛，但人类注视本质上具有随机性，预测困难。该随机性受到三方面结构化因素的约束：注视（fixation）与扫视（saccade）交替的时间动态、任务驱动的自上而下影响、以及视觉显著性的自下而上影响。现有方法未充分利用这些结构化约束，需要一种能显式建模注视随机性与结构化动态的框架。

Method: 提出GazeFlow，将注视直接建模为时间上注视位置的联合分布，条件为自上而下与自下而上信息。核心采用条件流匹配（conditional flow matching, CFM）：学习一个速度场（velocity field），通过迭代方式将高斯噪声样本传输到从该联合分布中采样的合理注视轨迹。速度场以视频编码器提取的自下而上视觉特征，以及通过对这些特征进行全局查询得到的自上而下任务信息为条件。

Result: 在标准数据集上，GazeFlow在逐帧（per-frame）指标上取得了当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能；同时生成的注视轨迹在时间动态上更贴合人类注视行为。

Conclusion: 将注视建模为条件联合分布并借助条件流匹配生成轨迹，能有效刻画注视的随机性与结构化时间动态，兼顾逐帧预测精度与轨迹动态的真实性。

Abstract: Egocentric gaze prediction enables many downstream applications but remains challenging, as human gaze is inherently stochastic. This stochasticity is constrained by structured temporal dynamics alternating between fixations and saccades, top-down influences from tasks, and bottom-up visual saliency. Based on this observation, we introduce GazeFlow, a framework that directly models gaze as a joint distribution of temporal gaze positions conditioned upon both top-down and bottom-up information. In particular, GazeFlow uses conditional flow matching (CFM): a learned velocity field iteratively transports a Gaussian noise sample into a plausible gaze trajectory drawn from this joint distribution. The velocity field is conditioned on bottom-up visual features extracted by a video encoder and on top-down task information obtained by globally querying these features. On standard datasets, GazeFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance on per-frame metrics, and the generated trajectories align better with human gaze temporal dynamics.

</details>

*Donghao Zhou,Haoyang He,Fan Zhang,Hao Yang,Guisheng Liu,Xin Gao,Zhongwei Wan,Xingyuan Bu,Jie Wang,Qiangpeng Yang,Shilei Wen,Chi-Wing Fu,Pheng-Ann Heng*

Conclusion: 显式激活MLLM推理并将其转化为生成条件，是提升复杂指令引导视频编辑的有效路径，且较小规模模型通过推理驱动设计可超越更大规模基线。

Abstract: Instruction-guided video editing has made significant progress, yet existing methods use multimodal large language models (MLLMs) primarily as semantic encoders, so they often fall short in working with implicit edits that require causal or semantic reasoning. To bridge this fundamental gap in video editing, we propose ThinkV2V, a reasoning-driven framework for complex instruction-guided video editing, explicitly activating MLLM thinking before visual generation. At its core, ThinkV2V builds on a practical MLLM-to-DiT architecture to turn explicit thinking over the source video and instruction into refined conditioning signals for video editing. Further, we equip it with a dedicated training and inference recipe, combining Progressive Curriculum Training, which gradually cultivates the model from basic editing to reasoning-intensive cases, with Inference-Time Thinking Scaling, which iteratively refines candidate prompts and selects the most reliable one, to better elicit reasoning in challenging editing scenarios.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Mycosis fungoides (MF) is a rare form of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma that is often misdiagnosed in early stages due to its visual similarity to benign inflammatory dermatoses. Early and accurate diagnosis is critical for improving patient outcomes. In this paper, we propose a comprehensive diagnostic framework for automated MF detection that combines dual- scale histopathological image analysis with deep learning. To distinguish MF from other lymphoproliferative skin conditions, the proposed approach leverages a late-fusion ensemble of dual- magnification (10x and 20x) convolutional neural networks (CNNs), complemented by a random forest classifier trained on 16 clinical features. Experimental results on an expanded dataset of 6,267 images (4,306 MF; 1,961 Non-MF) across 463 patients demonstrate that strong detection performance is obtained by prioritizing higher-resolution cytological details (20x) within broader architectural context (10x). The image-based late-fusion model achieves an accuracy of 83.58% and a sensitivity of 89.13%, while the clinical random forest model achieves an accuracy of 96.6% and sensitivity of 93.8%, highlighting the po- tential of this multimodal framework as a robust clinical decision support system in dermatology. This framework addresses two distinct clinical objectives: an image-based dual-scale pipeline optimized for the early diagnostic screening of MF versus non- MF dermatoses, and a complementary clinical metadata model designed for the subsequent staging of confirmed MF cases (patch/plaque versus tumor)

</details>


### [26] [LongTake: Learning to Sustain Dynamics in Long-Horizon Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38562)
*Byoungwoo Park,Jaemoo Choi,Juho Lee,Yongxin Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 LongTake，一种围绕长时域教师强制（Long-Horizon TF）的两阶段训练流程，用于提升自回归视频扩散模型在长时长 rollout 中的动态性与视觉质量，并与 DMD 蒸馏结合形成 Hybrid DMD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型、游戏模拟器和长镜头视频创作需要长时间内连贯的场景演化与持续动态。自回归视频扩散适合长时域生成，但长 rollout 常出现近乎静止或视觉质量退化。作者假设这些失败源于短视频监督对长时域场景动态演化的引导不足。

Method: LongTake 为两阶段训练流程：第一阶段在精选真实长视频上执行 Long-Horizon Teacher Forcing，让 AR 模型以长真值视频前缀为条件预测后续帧，将直接监督扩展到短训练时域之外；第二阶段进行分布匹配蒸馏（DMD），且无需标准流程中的中间少步蒸馏阶段。Hybrid DMD 进一步复用该 teacher，将监督扩展到自 rollout 的后续帧，同时保留初始窗口的双向联合监督。

Result: 在相同的 5 秒 DMD 训练设置下，Long-Horizon TF 初始化在 30 秒 rollout 上取得显著高于短时域 TF 初始化的动态度，且美学质量相当，并在两项指标上超过所评估基线。Hybrid DMD 在长时域自 rollout 中于 30s 和 60s 均取得所评估方法中最高的动态度。

Conclusion: LongTake 位于动态度与美学质量的 Pareto 前沿，表明长时域教师强制能为 DMD 提供更强的直接初始化，从而在长视频生成中兼顾动态保持与视觉质量。

Abstract: World models, game simulators, and long-take video creation require coherent scene evolution and sustained dynamics over extended durations. Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion provides a natural framework for long-horizon generation, yet extended rollouts often become near-static or lose visual quality. We hypothesize that these failures reflect the limited guidance provided by short-video supervision on how ongoing scene dynamics develops over longer durations. This motivates us to introduce LongTake, a two-stage training pipeline built around Long-Horizon Teacher Forcing (TF) on curated real long videos. Long-Horizon TF trains the AR model to predict later frames conditioned on long ground-truth video prefixes, extending direct supervision beyond the short training horizon. This supervision is designed to help the model sustain dynamics and preserve visual quality during long-horizon generation. Our central finding is that this training stage strengthens direct initialization for distribution matching distillation (DMD) under student self-rollout, without the intermediate few-step distillation stage used in standard pipelines. Under the same five-second DMD training setup, our initialization yields substantially higher dynamic degree than short horizon TF initialization on 30-second rollouts at comparable aesthetic quality, and surpasses the evaluated baselines in both measures. Hybrid DMD further reuses this teacher to extend supervision to later frames of the self-rollout while retaining bidirectional joint supervision over the initial window. On long-horizon self-rollouts, LongTake lies on the Pareto front of dynamic degree and aesthetic quality, and Hybrid DMD attains the highest dynamic degree among evaluated methods at both 30s and 60s.

</details>


### [27] [Retargeting Motions to Diverse Skeletons via Learnable Flattening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38578)
*Kia-Jüng Yang,Fabian H. Sinz,Paweł A. Pierzchlewicz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种Transformer自编码器，通过可学习的骨骼图扁平化与乘法式图位置编码，构建拓扑与平移不变的隐空间，实现跨结构动作重定向，零样本下全局关节位置误差降低43-47%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨结构动作重定向需在不同骨骼拓扑间迁移动作。现有SOTA模型在零样本（训练未见拓扑）场景下可靠性不足，且基于Transformer的方法未能超越专门的几何方法。作者旨在弥补这一差距。

Method: 核心是可学习的骨骼图扁平化，同时捕获局部依赖与全局结构；与标准Transformer将位置信息加性注入token不同，采用乘法式整合图位置编码，该设计直接源于扁平化公式。模型为单一统一架构处理多样拓扑，且完全无监督训练，无需配对重定向数据。

Result: 消融实验表明图编码、乘法式公式与Transformer骨干对性能均关键。零样本评估中，全局关节位置误差相比现有基准降低43-47%。用户研究（n=37，含专业动画师）显示本方法在动作对齐与物理合理性上排名最高（p<0.05）。

Conclusion: 模型设计是使Transformer架构在动作重定向中有效发挥的关键，所提方法超越现有方法，验证了图扁平化与乘法式位置编码的有效性。

Abstract: Cross-structural motion retargeting aims to transfer motion between different skeletal topologies. Despite recent progress, existing state-of-the-art models struggle with reliability in zero-shot settings, i.e. skeletons with different topologies which were unseen during training, and recent Transformer-based attempts have failed to outperform specialized geometric methods. We bridge this gap with a Transformer Autoencoder that learns a topology- and translation-invariant latent space. Our core contribution is a learnable flattening of skeletal graphs that captures both local dependencies and global structure. Unlike the standard transformer architecture, which adds positional information to token content, we integrate graph-based positional encodings multiplicatively, a design choice that follows directly from our flattening formulation. The resulting model handles diverse skeletal topologies within a single unified architecture and trains in a fully unsupervised manner, requiring no paired retargeting data. Ablation studies show, that the graph encodings, multiplicative formulation, and Transformer backbone is critical for the performance. In zero-shot evaluations, our method reduces global joint position error by $43-47\%$ over current benchmarks. A user study ($n = 37$), including expert animators, further ranks our approach highest in motion alignment and physical plausibility ($p < 0.05$). These results demonstrate that our model design is key to making transformer architectures effective for motion retargeting, outperforming existing approaches.

</details>


### [28] [Restoring without Forgetting: Filter-Level Continual Image Restoration via Parameter-Space Integrated Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38591)
*Xin Feng,Jin Zhao,Yizhen Zhang,Wenjie Pei,Fanglin Chen,Guangming Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RwF，一种滤波级持续适配框架，通过定位退化关键滤波器并从滤波器库生成任务特定滤波器，在不访问旧数据的情况下避免遗忘，恢复质量可媲美全数据方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像恢复模型在适应新任务流时，若不重访旧数据会产生灾难性遗忘。已有方法在持续适配与参数效率之间难以兼顾。

Method: 基于"任务特定知识集中在少数滤波器、且可与重建通用内容的滤波器分离"的观察，RwF首先用参数空间积分梯度归因，以粗到细方式定位退化关键滤波器；再用紧凑的分解低秩变换从滤波器库生成任务特定滤波器，辅以跨任务注意力和原型对比学习；最后仅在定位位置组装回模型。

Result: 在六个恢复任务上，RwF有效避免遗忘，恢复质量与拥有全部数据的all-in-one方法相当，并以约10倍更少的额外参数优于LoRA式适配。

Conclusion: 滤波级定位加低秩生成的任务特定滤波器是实现无遗忘、参数高效图像恢复持续适配的有效途径。

Abstract: Adapting image restoration models to a stream of new tasks without revisiting past data remains challenging due to catastrophic forgetting. In this work, we propose Restoring without Forgetting (RwF), a filter-level continual adaptation framework for image restoration built upon a critical observation: task-specific knowledge is centered in a small subset of filters and can be separated from those reconstructing general content. RwF first performs parameter-space integrated gradients attribution to localize degradation-critical filters in a coarse-to-fine manner. It then adapts to new tasks by generating task-specific filters from a filter bank using compact factorized low-rank transformations, further augmented with cross-task attention and prototypical contrastive learning, and lastly assembles them back only at localized positions. Experiments on six restoration tasks show that RwF effectively avoids forgetting and achieves competitive restoration quality against all-in-one methods that have full data access, and outperforms LoRA-style adaptation with $\sim$10$\times$ fewer additional parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/funkdub/Restoring-without-Forgetting.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 从单个标定双目图像对直接预测度量3DGS表示：复用冻结预训练立体网络的中间表示以预测高斯属性，用标定视差锚定几何；设置第二个高斯层与扩展图像画布以覆盖去遮挡及视场外内容；构建SceneSplat-Stereo数据集，用质量过滤的3DGS教师模型生成配对的双目输入与邻近目标视角，覆盖803个训练场景。

Conclusion: StereoGaussians实现了从单对双目图像前馈预测度量3DGS，为双目相机场景下的邻近视角外推与新视角合成提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables reconstruction without per- scene optimisation, but practical stereo-camera applications require nearby-view extrapolation beyond the input views. Stereo depth anchors visible surfaces, yet rendering newly exposed regions also requires learned appearance and additional scene capacity. We introduce StereoGaussians, which predicts a metric 3DGS representation from a single calibrated stereo pair. It reuses intermediate repre- sentations from frozen pretrained stereo networks to predict Gaussian attributes, while calibrated disparity anchors the geometry. A second Gaussian layer and an expanded image canvas provide capacity for disoccluded and outside-field-of- view content. For training, we construct SceneSplat-Stereo from quality-filtered 3DGS teachers, pairing stereo inputs with nearby target views across 803 training scenes. Experiments on unseen real and photorealistic stereo benchmarks demon- strate improvements over strong view-synthesis baselines, while ablation studies support our main design choices.

</details>


### [30] [PixelUMM: Encoder-Free Unified Image and Video Understanding and Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38597)
*Cong Wei,Xuanchi Ren,Bryan Chu,Weiming Ren,Huan Ling,Jiahui Huang,Laura Leal-Taixé,Sanja Fidler,Wenhu Chen,Zian Wang,Jay Zhangjie Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PixelUMM 提出一种无编码器的统一多模态模型，直接在像素空间完成图像与视频的理解和生成，通过空间 patch 与时空 tubelet 结合共享骨干，取得具竞争力的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型（UMMs）通常在理解与生成时使用独立的视觉表示，增加了视觉上下文长度，并使与已有视觉-语言预训练流程的集成变得复杂。虽有像素空间建模提供无编码器方案，但从图像扩展到视频并不简单：视频理解与生成采用不同的时间表示，统一视觉接口的设计仍是开放问题。

Method: PixelUMM 直接以像素空间建模图像与视频。将图像表示为空间 patch，视频表示为时空 tubelet，通过单层线性投影将原始像素连接到共享多模态骨干。其 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构结合共享注意力与任务特定参数，并将 clean-pixel 预测扩展到视频生成，同时支持自回归文本预测与像素空间流匹配（flow matching）。

Result: 实验表明，PixelUMM 在图像与视频的理解和生成任务上均取得具竞争力的表现。作者还对关键设计选择（如解码器设计、时空 patch 大小）进行了实证研究，为未来像素空间统一多模态模型提供洞见。

Conclusion: PixelUMM 验证了无编码器、纯像素空间的统一多模态建模范式可同时覆盖图像与视频的理解与生成，并揭示关键设计权衡。

Abstract: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) often rely on separate visual representations for understanding and generation, increasing visual context length and complicating integration with established vision-language pretraining pipelines. Recent advances in pixel-space modeling offer an encoder-free alternative, but extending this paradigm from images to videos is non-trivial: video understanding and generation adopt different temporal representations, leaving the design of a unified visual interface an open question. We present PixelUMM, an encoder-free model for unified image and video understanding and generation directly in pixel space. PixelUMM represents images as spatial patches and videos as spatiotemporal tubelets, connecting raw pixels to a shared multimodal backbone through single-layer linear projections. Its Mixture-of-Transformers architecture combines shared attention with task-specific parameters and extends clean-pixel prediction to video generation, jointly supporting autoregressive text prediction and pixel-space flow matching. Experiments show that PixelUMM achieves competitive performance across image and video understanding and generation tasks. We further conduct empirical studies of key design choices, including decoder design and spatial-temporal patch size, providing insights for future pixel-space unified multimodal models.

</details>


### [31] [Aperture: Training-Free Multiscale Concept Bottlenecks for Remote Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38603)
*Rishabh Mondal,Nipun Batra,Utkarsh Mall*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 APERTURE：一种免训练的概念瓶颈模型，通过多尺度图像空间与 MLLM 概念空间融合，实现遥感领域可解释且 SOTA 的性能，并发布细粒度概念数据集 SiFC。

Abstract: Neural implicit representations have had a significant impact on scene reconstruction by enabling robots to build continuous, differentiable, and high-fidelity 3D maps. More specifically, the learnable map features can be converted to the output with the query and decoding process for both training and inference. For large-scale representation, we decompose a scene into overlapping submaps and do hierarchical optimization within each local submap, thus enabling scalable computation. To correct estimation drift among submaps, we align and fuse them entirely within the implicit feature space, leading to substantial acceleration by avoiding the need to decode the final output. Abstract: Reconstructing and animating water scenery from nature produces compelling and immersive visual experiences. Abstract: Visual object tracking typically assumes that the initial template and subsequent search frames share the same sensing modality. Accordingly, we introduce TSDA-Track, a Template-Search Domain Adaptation framework to reduce modality discrepancy during training. We investigate two feature alignment strategies. Pre-AFA TSDA-Track applies adversarial alignment before transformer's template-search interaction to suppress modality-specific bias. Enc-CFA TSDA-Track applies contrastive alignment to encoder representations after interaction to strengthen target-level cross-modal correspondence. Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models have recently emerged as one of the prevailing solutions for autonomous driving, as they can utilize knowledge acquired during vision-language pretraining for accurate and interpretable driving. Abstract: Cinematic camera motion is a fundamental storytelling tool, defined not only by where the camera is positioned in the scene, but also by how it moves in terms of direction and speed. Further, temporal and stereo inconsistencies that may be tolerable on conventional displays can become highly disruptive when viewed through an immersive headset.

Inspired from binocular vision and depth perception, we develop an epipolar-aware $360^\circ$ image matching metric that captures the temporal and stereo geometric inconsistencies across views. We then use this metric as a preference signal for direct preference optimization with limited training data. TL;DR: 本文提出 SEGUE 框架，通过训练无关规划器生成中间过渡提示（segue prompts）并配合 SPANDMD 训练策略，使流式视频生成器在中途切换提示时能够忠实执行状态过渡，在 OpenTrans-360 与 StreamAV-Bench 上取得领先性能。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Streaming video generators allow users to dynamically modulate video synthesis via mid-stream prompt switching. Furthermore, to address the inherent difficulty of training causal models on short-lived temporal schedules without corrupting preparatory supervision, we introduce SPANDMD, which evaluates each active prompt using the full rollout as temporal context while retaining its DMD residual only within the prompt's assigned span.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Foundation models for computational pathology are usually evaluated using AUC and accuracy, while calibration is often left untested. This matters because a model can be accurate on average but still assign overly confident probabilities to cases that are difficult even for pathologists. We study calibration across eight pathology foundation models. Using pathologist agreement as a measure of diagnostic difficulty, we find that calibration error is consistently higher on low-agreement cases than on high-agreement cases. This pattern is not apparent from aggregate expected calibration error (ECE) alone. We then propose synthetic agreement calibration, a method for improving calibration without collecting multi-annotator labels. Given a trained linear probe, we select high-confidence embeddings as class anchors and interpolate between anchors from opposite classes. The interpolation weights encode a continuous notion of diagnostic ambiguity, which we use as a synthetic agreement signal to retrain the probe with agreement-aware label smoothing. On MHIST, which includes annotations from seven pathologists, synthetic agreement calibration recovers most of the calibration improvement obtained by label smoothing based on real pathologist agreement, while substantially reducing low-agreement ECE relative to the uncalibrated baseline. Discrimination metrics are preserved. On PatchCamelyon and BreakHis, public histopathology datasets without multi-annotator labels, the method improves calibration across the evaluated foundation models, whereas annotator-dependent approaches cannot be used without additional expert annotation.

Abstract: We describe our winning entry to the Waymo Open Dataset 2D Video Panoptic Segmentation Challenge. The task asks for a semantic class at every pixel of every frame and, for countable objects, an identity that holds across 100 frames and across five overlapping cameras. We build on DVIS++, a cascade of a segmenter, a tracker, and a refiner, as our baseline. We propose hard region supervision (HRS) to improve the baseline. In particular, we use the baseline to define the hard region as where it makes mistakes, and design a loss and an auxiliary prediction head for this region. The auxiliary head is used only in training and removed at test time, so at inference the model trained with HRS has the same architecture as the baseline. In addition, we propose three test-time steps that further improve the results: a two-model ensemble, a merge of the segmenter's output into the final panoptic map, and cross-camera identity linking. On the challenge test set, our entry reaches 0.3547 wSTQ, 0.2071 wAQ, and 0.6075 mIoU, ranking first on all three metrics. It is 3.6 wSTQ points ahead of the second entry and 2.4 points ahead of our DVIS++ baseline.

### [45] [SpatialCORE: Confidence-Aware Grounded Spatial Reasoning in Large Vision--Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38716)
*Rafi Ibn Sultan,Xiangyu Zhou,Md. Sajid Alam Chowdhury,Chengyin Li,Prashant Khanduri,Marco Brocanelli,Dongxiao Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SpatialCORE后训练框架，将模型对生成式grounding的自身置信度作为空间推理的学习信号，通过自调节空间奖励与答案门控，在多个基准上达到开源及专用空间推理模型的SOTA，并可零样本迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在视觉感知任务上进步显著，但空间推理仍是持续短板，尤其是需要基于视觉空间进行推理的问题。现有引入生成式grounding的空间推理方法仅优化最终答案正确性，导致即使模型并未依据高置信度定位的任务相关物体进行推理，正确答案也会被奖励，因而缺乏对"是否真的从可靠定位处推理"的约束。

Method: SpatialCORE（Spatially COnfident REasoning）是一种后训练框架，核心思想是强化既准确又自信的grounding，促使模型从高置信度定位的任务相关物体出发进行推理。具体实现包括：(1) 自调节空间奖励（self-regulating spatial reward），用每个预测边界框的坐标token置信度对其匹配质量进行加权；(2) 答案门控（answer gate），将grounding优化与最终答案正确性绑定。

Result: 在多样化的基准上，SpatialCORE在开源模型与专用空间推理模型中均取得state-of-the-art结果，并在零样本设置下有效迁移到未见过的数据分布。源代码已开源（https://github.com/rafiibnsultan/SpatialCORE）。

Conclusion: 将模型自身对生成式grounding的置信度转化为学习信号，可有效提升LVLM的空间推理能力；自调节空间奖励与答案门控的结合，既保证了定位的准确与自信，又将其与答案正确性对齐，并展现出良好的泛化与迁移能力。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have made remarkable progress across visual perception tasks, yet spatial reasoning remains a persistent weakness, especially for questions that require reasoning over visual space. Recent spatial-reasoning methods incorporate generated grounding, where models predict bounding boxes, masks, or other localization outputs for task-relevant objects as part of their reasoning trace. However, these approaches typically optimize final-answer correctness alone, allowing correct answers to be rewarded even when the model does not reason from confidently localized task-relevant objects. We introduce SpatialCORE (Spatially COnfident REasoning), a post-training framework that turns the model's own confidence in generated grounding into a learning signal for spatial reasoning. Its central idea is to reinforce grounding that is both accurate and confident, encouraging the model to reason from confidently localized task-relevant objects. SpatialCORE realizes this through a self-regulating spatial reward that weights each predicted bounding box's matching quality by its coordinate-token confidence. An answer gate further ties grounding optimization to final-answer correctness. SpatialCORE achieves state-of-the-art results among open-source and specialized spatial reasoning models across diverse benchmarks, and transfers effectively in zero-shot settings to unseen data distributions. The source code is available at https://github.com/rafiibnsultan/SpatialCORE.

</details>


### [46] [Soft Spatial Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38717)
*Rafi Ibn Sultan,Md. Sajid Alam Chowdhury,Saleh Zare Zade,Chengyin Li,Prashant Khanduri,Marco Brocanelli,Dongxiao Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Soft Spatial Reasoning后训练框架，通过软思维（混合token嵌入）与AdaptSoft自适应控制器，缓解LVLM空间推理中的过早离散化问题，在多个空间基准上超越硬/固定软CoT及现有LVLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVLM通常以CoT进行空间推理，将中间推理编码为离散语言token的自回归序列。这种"硬思维"要求每步必须提交单一token，即使正确的空间解释尚不确定，导致过早离散化：一次错误的token选择会在后续推理中传播误差。

Method: 提出Soft Spatial Reasoning后训练框架，在空间任务中引入软思维：每步通过混合token嵌入形成连续软状态，而非选择单一token，使多个候选延续能影响下一步。核心为AdaptSoft控制器，利用当前隐藏状态与预测不确定性自适应调节每步的软度。为训练AdaptSoft，提出梯度对齐学习目标，在无中间推理监督下为软度控制提供步特定学习信号。

Result: 在多样空间基准上，Soft Spatial Reasoning优于相同主干的硬CoT与固定软度CoT基线，也优于多种现有LVLM。源代码已开源。

Conclusion: 以连续软状态替代离散token选择，并逐步自适应控制软度，可有效缓解空间推理中的过早离散化与误差传播，为LVLM空间推理提供了一种有效的后训练方案。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) commonly perform spatial reasoning through chain-of-thought (CoT), encoding intermediate reasoning as autoregressive sequences of discrete language tokens. This early commitment constitutes premature discretization: an incorrect token selection can propagate errors through subsequent reasoning. The appropriate degree of softness, however, can vary across reasoning steps: retaining multiple candidates may preserve a useful spatial interpretation, but if those candidates imply conflicting spatial relations, mixing them may interfere with subsequent reasoning. At the core of Soft Spatial Reasoning is AdaptSoft, a controller that uses the current hidden state and predictive uncertainty to adapt the degree of softness at each reasoning step. To train AdaptSoft, we introduce a gradient-alignment learning objective that provides a step-specific learning signal for softness control without intermediate reasoning supervision. Across diverse spatial benchmarks, Soft Spatial Reasoning outperforms hard and fixed-soft CoT baselines using the same backbone, as well as a range of existing LVLMs. The source code is available at https://github.com/rafiibnsultan/Soft_Spatial_Reasoning

Abstract: How can a 3D reconstruction system acquire and retain useful information to understand the geometry of a scene from partial views under a limited computation budget? Abstract: Reference-guided camouflaged object detection aims to segment a target whose visual appearance closely resembles its surroundings by exploiting auxiliary reference samples. To handle these problems, we present a consensus-aware multi-source fusion framework. Reference-Conditioned Dual-Backbone Fusion (RCDF) couples trainable PVTv2 query features with frozen DINOv3 representations and uses reference-conditioned correlation to select foundation-model evidence before multi-scale fusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results further show that reference consensus, target-conditioned foundation features, and hierarchical decoding provide complementary improvements under the evaluation protocol. ### [49] [Here the World in Stereo: Learning Dynamic Spatial Correspondence for Immersive Joint Video-Audio Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38748)
*Hanmo Chen,Chengcheng Liu,Tianxiao Chen,Zheyu Zhang,Siming Zheng,Jinwei Chen,Xu Yang,Cheng Deng,Bo Li,Peng-tao Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 StereoBind 框架，将视觉源运动绑定到立体声生成，并从数据与评测两方面构建支撑，显著提升空间一致性。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: StereoBind 以运动轨迹（motion tracks）协调视觉运动与立体声，包含三种互补机制：视觉运动绑定（Visual Motion Binding）建立源感知的音视频对应；空间轨迹编码器（Spatial Track Encoder）捕捉声源绝对位置；残差轨迹 RoPE（Residual Track RoPE）建模相对运动。同时构建 StereoWorld-29K（大规模立体声音视频数据集，含配对运动轨迹）用于监督，并构建 StereoWorldBench 用于评测音视频空间一致性。

Abstract: Recent joint video-audio generation models have achieved strong semantic correspondence and temporal synchronization. However, applications such as AR/VR and interactive gaming further require stereo audio to provide an immersive sense, which remains largely overlooked. Effective stereo audio requires the perceived sound location to evolve consistently with the motion of its corresponding visual source. We refer to this property as Dynamic Spatial Correspondence and propose StereoBind, a framework that binds visual source motion to stereo sound generation. StereoBind uses motion tracks to coordinate visual motion and stereo audio through three complementary mechanisms. Visual Motion Binding establishes source-aware audiovisual correspondence, the Spatial Track Encoder captures absolute source positions, and Residual Track RoPE models relative motion. For supervision and evaluation, we construct StereoWorld-29K, a large-scale stereo audio-video dataset with paired motion tracks, and StereoWorldBench for measuring audiovisual spatial consistency. Experiments show that StereoBind substantially improves spatial alignment in stereo audio generation over existing models while preserving overall audiovisual quality.

</details>

*Zhining Gu,Shangjie Du,Weimin Qiu,Carl Olsson,Ping Liu,Meng Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 PoseAgent，一种通过可学习排序与验证动态编排多种相机位姿估计器的智能体框架，在多个基准上优于最强单一估计器（AUC@5° 最高提升 4.2%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有位姿估计方法（对应点法、端到端回归、3D 几何基础模型）各有优劣，没有单一估计器能应对宽基线、弱纹理、外观变化和遮挡等多样挑战；实验还表明不同估计器在基准和单对图像上性能差异大且具互补性。

Method: PoseAgent 包含三个可学习组件：profiling agent 提取与位姿估计相关的表观、语义、几何特征（如场景类型）；ranking agent 依据图像对画像预测各估计器的相对胜任度；verification agent 对执行的最优估计结果预测位姿误差，验证失败则自适应调用更低排名估计器，直至候选被接受或达到执行预算。

Result: 验证网络预测位姿误差比先前模型更准确；在 ARKitScenes、MegaDepth、ScanNet++、RealEstate10K 上，AUC@5° 相比各自最强单一估计器提升最高 4.2%；在 ARKitScenes 上还优于采用相同验证器与回退策略的 VLM 排序智能体。

Conclusion: 通过动态编排多个互补估计器，结合可学习的排序与验证机制，能显著提升相对相机位姿估计性能，验证了学习式排序与验证的有效性。

Abstract: A wide range of approaches have been developed for camera pose estimation, including correspondence-based methods, end-to-end pose regression, and recent 3D geometric foundation models. Our key observation is that no single estimator is optimal for diverse challenges, such as wide baselines, lack of texture, appearance changes, and occlusions. Further analysis reveals substantial performance variation across both benchmarks and individual image pairs, with different estimators exhibiting complementary strengths. We introduce PoseAgent, an agentic framework for relative camera pose estimation that dynamically orchestrates pose estimators through learnable ranking and verification. Given an image pair, a profiling agent first extracts appearance, semantic, and geometric features relevant to pose estimation, e.g., scene type. A learned ranking agent then predicts the relative competence of multiple pose estimators given the image-pair profile. The top-ranked estimator is executed, and its predicted pose is assessed by a learned verification agent that estimates the corresponding pose error. When verification fails, PoseAgent adaptively invokes lower-ranked estimators until a candidate is accepted or the execution budget is reached. For pose verification, our verification network predicts pose errors more accurately than prior models. For pose estimation, PoseAgent improves AUC@5 degree up to 4.2% over the strongest standalone estimator on each of ARKitScenes, MegaDepth, ScanNet++, and RealEstate10K. On ARKitScenes, PoseAgent also outperforms VLM-based agents, which include a VLM ranker with the same verifier and fallback policy. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our learned ranking and verification.

</details>

*Abu Hanif Muhammad Syarubany,Jaehyun Jang,Siwoo Lim,Seungyeon Ryu,Chang D. Yoo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EDRRM，通过事件驱动的刷新与循环记忆机制增强Sa2VA，在长动态视频中减少过期定位与持续误检，实现精度-效率的竞争性权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Sa2VA将多模态大语言模型与SAM2结合用于指代视频目标分割，但其推理通常仅从少量固定初始关键帧进行定位，随后依赖传播。在长视频或动态视频中，当目标构成发生变化（如干扰物进入或目标消失/重现）时，会导致定位过期和持续性的假阳性失败。

Method: 提出事件驱动刷新+循环记忆（EDRRM）。仅在稳定变化点选择性地重新调用Sa2VA。使用由跟踪线索（新生/消亡及粗略构成/布局变化）计算并经EMA平滑的事件分数，结合时间约束触发刷新边界；循环记忆进一步通过CLIP相似度检索锚帧，以在目标重现事件时重新条件化模型。

Result: 在Ref-DAVIS17、MeViS和ReVOS上，EDRRM相较于固定窗口和FrameDiff-SSIM基线取得竞争性的精度-效率权衡，在显著更低的平均刷新调用预算下保持相当或更优的J&F分数，并减少假阳性失败。端到端运行时分析证实，跟踪、CLIP循环匹配与可识别性门控的开销相对于占主导的Sa2VA推理成本较为适中。

Conclusion: EDRRM通过事件驱动的选择性刷新与循环记忆检索，有效缓解Sa2VA在长动态视频中的定位过期问题，在保持或提升分割精度的同时大幅降低刷新调用开销，验证了该流水线的高效性。

Abstract: Referring Video Object Segmentation (RVOS) aims to produce a pixel-accurate mask sequence for an object specified by natural language. Sa2VA combines a multimodal large language model with SAM2 for grounded segmentation; however, its inference typically grounds the query from a small fixed set of initial keyframes and then relies on propagation. In long or dynamic videos, this can cause stale grounding and persistent false positives when the object composition changes (e.g., distractors enter or the target disappears/re-appears). We propose Event-Driven Refresh + Recurrence Memory (EDRRM), an enhancement that selectively re-invokes Sa2VA only at stable change points. EDRRM triggers refresh boundaries using an EMA-smoothed event score computed from tracking-derived cues (births/deaths and coarse composition/layout changes) with temporal constraints. A recurrence memory further retrieves anchor frames via CLIP similarity to re-condition the model on re-appearance events. Experiments on Ref-DAVIS17, MeViS, and ReVOS show that EDRRM achieves a competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-off relative to fixed-window and FrameDiff-SSIM baselines, maintaining comparable or superior J&F scores at substantially lower average refresh-call budgets and reducing false-positive failures. End-to-end runtime analysis further confirms that the overhead introduced by tracking, CLIP-based recurrence matching, and the identifiability gate remains modest relative to the dominant Sa2VA inference cost, thereby validating the efficiency of the proposed pipeline.

</details>


### [52] [Distill the Visual Evidence, Not Just the Answer: Cross-World On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38777)
*Yuanhao Sun,Huawei Ji,Jiaxin Ding,Luoyi Fu,Xinbing Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出跨世界在线策略蒸馏（CW-OPD），通过对视觉证据变化下的教师信念转移进行显式监督，使学生的视觉理解成为蒸馏的显式目标，并引入CWBench评测跨世界一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM蒸馏方法主要监督学生输出，导致视觉理解被隐式处理。分析发现学生可以不经由相同视觉证据就匹配教师答案，因此需要确保学生真正基于决定答案的视觉信息作出响应。

Method: 为每个样例构造两个共享问题与场景但答案关键证据不同的视觉世界，产生不同答案；在两个世界中进行在线策略蒸馏，并对教师的跨世界信念转移进行蒸馏，使学生不仅匹配教师预测什么，也匹配预测因证据而改变的原因。梯度分析表明该项对两世界共有误差不变，提供端点匹配无法给出的校正信号。

Result: 在Qwen3.5-4B上，CW-OPD平均超过最强基线1.2分；4B学生在CWBench上以22.4 CWPA分超过DeepSeek-V4.1（552B）。

Conclusion: CW-OPD将依赖相关视觉证据从输出匹配的隐式结果转变为显式蒸馏目标，并通过CWBench的跨世界对准确率（CWPA）诊断模型是否真正基于视觉证据作答。

Abstract: A central goal of vision-language model (VLM) distillation is to transfer both the teacher's language capabilities and its visual understanding. However, existing methods primarily supervise the student's output, leaving visual understanding implicit. Our analysis reveals that a student can match the teacher's answer without relying on the same visual evidence, raising the question: how can we ensure the student responds to the visual information that actually determines the answer? To this end, we propose \textbf{Cross-World On-Policy Distillation (CW-OPD)}, which explicitly supervises the student's response to changes in visual evidence. For each example, CW-OPD constructs two visual worlds that share the question and scene context but differ in answer-critical evidence, yielding different answers. We perform on-policy distillation in both worlds and distill the teacher's cross-world belief transition, encouraging the student to match not only \emph{what} the teacher predicts but also \emph{why} its prediction changes with the evidence. A gradient analysis shows that this term is invariant to errors shared by both worlds and supplies a corrective signal invisible to endpoint matching alone. In this way, CW-OPD makes reliance on the relevant visual evidence an explicit distillation target rather than an implicit consequence of output matching. To diagnose whether a model truly grounds its answers in visual evidence, we introduce CWBench, which measures cross-world consistency via Cross-World Pair Accuracy (CWPA). Experiments on Qwen3.5-4B show that CW-OPD outperforms the strongest baseline by \textbf{1.2} points on average, and the 4B student exceeds DeepSeek-V4.1 (552B) by \textbf{22.4} CWPA points on CWBench. Code is released in https://github.com/baokou-fw2/CWAD.

</details>


### [53] [CRAFT: Causal Responsibility and Failure Tracing in Medical Vision Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38810)
*Chunzheng Zhu,Jiaqi Zeng,Hongbo Zhao,Yihang Chen,Yijun Wang,Jianxin Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究揭示视觉语言模型在医学诊断中的两类安全失效（仲裁失效与刹车失效）由空间上互不重叠的注意力头群体介导，并提出CRAFT方法定位因果头集合，通过消融干预实现无需重训练的矫正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型日益应用于临床诊断，但现有机制分析局限于单模态文本，无法解释为何一句误导性文本能覆盖正确的图像诊断，或模型在视觉证据不足时仍给出高置信答案。理解模型内部如何解决视觉与文本信号冲突已成为安全刚需。

Method: 提出CRAFT方法：通过双重标准将每种失效模式定位到最小因果注意力头集合，利用时间探针和Tuned Lens轨迹分析验证其必要性与充分性；分别对仲裁头与刹车头进行消融。

Result: 仲裁头构成中深层宽带，反映跨层证据竞争；刹车头集中于中后层窄带，调控证据充分性与弃答行为。切除仲裁头显著降低冲突跟随且对干净输入影响极小；切除刹车头可在视觉证据退化时恢复适当弃答。两类干预靶向空间上互不重叠的头集合，产生不同矫正效果。

Conclusion: 在多个医学VQA基准和多种VLM架构上的实验验证了定位与干预的有效性，表明所识别注意力头因果驱动各自失效模式，且靶向调制可泛化且无需重训练，凸显两类失效模式的机制可分离性。

Abstract: As vision language models are increasingly deployed in clinical diagnosis, understanding how they internally resolve competing visual and textual signals becomes a safety imperative.
